introduction.text_002: Free practice for every band, orchestra and choir student.
introduction.text_003: Woodshed helps students practice fingerings, rhythm counting, solfège and lyrics on any phone, tablet or laptop. No sign-in, no download.

practice.text_006: See a note, choose the fingering, and learn your instrument one note at a time.
practice.text_008: Count rhythms out loud and check yourself as you go.
practice.text_009: Practice the syllables and pitches that choir rehearsals run on.
practice.text_011: Learn the words to every piece before the concert.
practice.text_012: Build an exercise for your own music.
practice.text_013: Build a custom exercise from the music your students are playing.
practice.text_014: Share it as a link in an announcement, on the board or anywhere else.
practice.text_015: Students open the link and start practicing.

linked.text_016: Linked to Program Partner, so practice shows up where you track progress.
linked.text_017: Woodshed works on its own for anyone. When you assign Woodshed practice from Program Partner, students open it from a link, and their results come back next to their Skill Pathways and practice logs.
linked.text_020: Send it to your students tonight.
linked.text_023: Woodshed All-Access, the subscription for directors, comes with every Program Partner plan at no extra cost.
